description: Synthetic track splits for the F1TENTH PPO-vs-SAC study. train is the existing training pool; val (checkpoint selection) and test (reporting) are the next 30 draws of the same seeded generator stream, disjoint from training.

generator.packaging: generate_track_pool.py layout: <name>/<name>_map.yaml, <name>_map.pgm, <name>_centerline.csv with columns x,y,w_left,w_right (widths fixed at 2.0)

vw_train.width_assignment: track k: half_width = 0.60 + 0.90 * vdc2(k + 1), van der Corput base 2, deterministic, in track order

vw_val.width_assignment: track k: half_width = 0.60 + 0.90 * vdc2(k + 1), van der Corput base 2, deterministic, in track order

vw_test.width_assignment: track k: half_width = 0.60 + 0.90 * vdc2(k + 1), van der Corput base 2, deterministic, in track order
